Question: How do I connect to the office Wi-Fi?
Answer: Join the *Corp-WiFi* network and sign in with your normal work email and password. Guests should use *Guest-WiFi* (the password is posted at reception). If it won't connect, forget the network and rejoin.
Alternate Phrases: how do I get on the wifi; connect to wifi; wifi password; what is the wifi password
Keyword Rules: (wifi OR "wi-fi" OR wireless OR internet) AND (connect OR join OR password OR login OR "log in") AND NOT guest

Question: My Wi-Fi keeps dropping. What should I do?
Answer: Toggle Wi-Fi off/on, then forget and rejoin *Corp-WiFi*. Move closer to an access point if you're in a corner room. If it keeps dropping for more than 15 minutes, post the room name in #it-help so we can check the access point.
Alternate Phrases: wifi keeps disconnecting; wifi is slow; internet is slow
Keyword Rules: (wifi OR "wi-fi" OR wireless OR internet) AND (dropping OR drops OR disconnect OR disconnecting OR slow OR unstable OR keeps)

Question: What is the guest Wi-Fi password?
Answer: Guest Wi-Fi details are posted at reception and rotate monthly. Guests must not be given Corp-WiFi credentials.
Alternate Phrases: guest wifi; visitor wifi; wifi for a guest
Keyword Rules: (wifi OR "wi-fi" OR wireless OR internet) AND (guest OR visitor OR client)

Question: How do I connect to the VPN?
Answer: Open the VPN client, choose the *Primary* gateway, and sign in with your work email. Approve the MFA prompt on your phone. You only need the VPN for internal file shares and admin tools - email and Slack work without it.
Alternate Phrases: connect to the vpn from home; how do I use the vpn; remote access
Keyword Rules: vpn OR "remote access" OR "work from home"

Question: The VPN won't connect. What should I try?
Answer: 1) Check your home internet works. 2) Quit and reopen the VPN client. 3) Make sure you approved the MFA prompt. 4) Switch to the *Backup* gateway. Still stuck? Post the exact error message in #it-help.
Alternate Phrases: vpn not working; vpn error; vpn keeps disconnecting
Keyword Rules: vpn AND (error OR fails OR failed OR "not working" OR "won't" OR wont OR disconnect OR disconnecting OR stuck)

Question: How do I add the office printer?
Answer: Mac: System Settings > Printers & Scanners > + and pick *Office-Printer-01*. Windows: Settings > Bluetooth & devices > Printers & scanners > Add device. You must be on Corp-WiFi or the VPN.
Alternate Phrases: add a printer; install printer; set up printer
Keyword Rules: (printer OR printing OR print) AND (add OR install OR setup OR "set up" OR connect)

Question: The printer is jammed or out of toner. Who do I tell?
Answer: Open the front panel and follow the on-screen jam diagram. For toner or hardware faults, post in #it-help with the printer name - spare toner is in the supply closet.
Alternate Phrases: printer jam; paper jam; printer out of toner; printer broken
Keyword Rules: (printer OR printing OR print OR paper) AND (jam OR jammed OR toner OR ink OR broken OR error OR "not working")

Question: How do I scan a document to email?
Answer: On the printer touchscreen tap *Scan to Email*, sign in with your badge, enter your address, and press Start. Scans arrive within a minute (check spam the first time).
Alternate Phrases: scan to email; how do I scan; scanner
Keyword Rules: scan OR scanner OR scanning

Answer: Go to the self-service password portal (https://password.example.com), choose *Forgot password*, and verify with MFA. Passwords need 14+ characters. IT will never ask for your password.

Answer: Accounts unlock automatically after 15 minutes. If you need in sooner, use the self-service password portal or ask in #it-help from another device.

Question: How do I set up MFA?
Answer: Install Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator, then go to https://mfa.example.com and scan the QR code. Add a backup phone number too, in case you lose your phone.

Question: I got a new phone. How do I move my MFA?
Answer: Before wiping the old phone, open your authenticator and use its transfer/export option. If the old phone is already gone, ask IT in #it-help to reset your MFA - we'll verify your identity by video call first.

Question: I think I got a phishing email. What should I do?
Answer: Don't click links or open attachments. Use the *Report Phishing* button in your mail client, or forward it as an attachment to security@example.com. If you already clicked or entered your password, reset your password and tell IT right away.
Alternate Phrases: suspicious email; phishing; scam email; spam
Keyword Rules: phishing OR phish OR scam OR suspicious OR "fake email"

Question: How do I set up email on my phone?
Answer: Install the Gmail or Outlook app, add your work account, and approve the MFA prompt. Your phone must have a screen lock enabled.

Question: How do I set an out-of-office reply?
Answer: In Gmail: Settings > See all settings > Vacation responder. In Outlook: File > Automatic Replies. Remember to set your Slack status too.

Question: My laptop is running slow. How can I speed it up?
Answer: Restart (not just close the lid) - most issues clear after a reboot. Install pending updates, quit unused apps and browser tabs, and keep 20GB+ disk free. If it's still slow, ask IT for a health check.
Alternate Phrases: computer is slow; laptop slow; mac is slow
Keyword Rules: (laptop OR computer OR mac OR pc OR machine) AND (slow OR sluggish OR lagging OR freezing)

Question: How do I connect to the conference room display?
Answer: Use the HDMI/USB-C cable on the table, or AirPlay/Cast to the room name shown on the screen. For video calls, select the room camera and speaker in your meeting app's settings.
Alternate Phrases: screen share in conference room; tv in meeting room; projector
Keyword Rules: (conference OR meeting OR room) AND (display OR screen OR tv OR projector OR hdmi OR airplay) AND NOT wifi

Question: My external monitor isn't detected.
Answer: Unplug and replug the cable, try another port, and check the monitor's input source. On Mac use System Settings > Displays > Detect Displays (hold Option). Dock issues usually clear after a restart.
Alternate Phrases: second monitor not working; monitor no signal; external display
Keyword Rules: (monitor OR display OR screen) AND ("not working" OR detected OR "no signal" OR black OR external OR second)
